Agent Name: Verification_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent provided incorrect data for the 2011 Bulgarian census regarding tertiary education. The correct figures are approximately 637,000 men and 871,000 women (a difference of ~234,000). The agent fabricated numbers (685,000 men and 755,000 women) which led to a calculation of 70,000 instead of the correct ~234,900. This data retrieval error was the root cause of the wrong final answer.
